The small circle at the corner is the channel switch: double-tap it to flip between the color reading and the pure-ink reading of the very same marks (filled circle = color, outline = ink).

title: Garden of Myths
note: His Crete sketchbook alive: a clay-ochre ground holding charcoal mythic creatures with Aegean-blue wings, horns and crests and bone-white eyes: a horned quadruped, a finned serpent, a winged horse, a horned head on a long neck, wandering slowly with room to breathe. Tap the ground and a creature walks in from the edge (five at most). Drag a path and the nearest creature follows it. Double-tap a creature and it molts into a new variant of its body plan.

title: The Reader Completes It
note: His wordless Little Red Riding Hood in five fixed scenes: the forest path with a tiny un-red hooded figure, the grandmother's house, the wolf's shadow across the path, the red hood itself (fabric-textured, the single red event, scene four only), and the dawn clearing. No text anywhere; you complete the story. Double-tap turns the page with a stepped paper wipe. A single tap is just a breath: the scene sways.

title: The Body as Lightning
note: His dance cover as a perpetual rehearsal: fourteen translucent dancer silhouettes in vermilion, indigo and ochre overlap edge to edge on paper, mid-leap and mid-turn, every edge bleeding like wash, the color deepening wherever bodies cross. They morph through their poses, fade in at the edges and dissolve at others. Drag sends a gust through the ensemble; nearby dancers lean and swirl, then recover. Tap does nothing.

title: Memory Like Fireflies
note: His Tatsuno abandoned house as a light instrument: near-black ground hiding a white-ink mural of bare winter trees and house beams. Twenty-four fireflies drift and glow out of phase; each amber glow briefly reveals the mural beneath it, then darkness takes it back. Two branch tips hold rare embers. Drag for a gust: the flies scatter, their glow flares, more mural surfaces, then all settles. The mural never changes and is never shown whole.

title: Where Images Are Born
note: His Sevilla method as the whole piece: the stain precedes the line. Six walnut and turmeric ink blots sit on the paper, and from each blot's own contour a creature is read out in thin ink: fox ears, a fish, a long-neck beast, a bird's beak, a dancer's limb, and one small hooded figure carrying the session's only red. Drag on empty paper to lay a new stain (it blooms, then a creature is read from its edge; nine blots at most). Tap a creature and it redraws itself from a new contour of the same blot.

title: Flat-Lay Bestiary
note: Her exhibition flyer alive: a pink textured-paper ground holding eight cutout creatures in balanced disorder (two hedgehogs, a bird with the one orange beak, a small elephant, a round white bird, a teardrop, an arch, a crescent), each with its paper edge shadow. Every few seconds one hops to a new spot in three stepped frames, as if a hand keeps rearranging them just out of frame. Drag to stir; tap a creature and it hops.

title: White on White
note: Her paper in a scale of whites: one continuous white sheet, embossed dunes flowing diagonally, incised line rivers, and exactly three sharp cut slits revealing warm shadow beneath. There is no color and no input at all; the light breathes on a sixty-second cycle and the reliefs appear and dissolve. This one is only for looking.

title: Strip Book
note: Her harlequinade as an object: five horizontal paper strips stack into one day garden (sun, ferns, hanging pods, the elephant pair, a creature band, a green hill), seams and curl shadows visible, a thin spine at left. Tap a strip and it flicks over, flat and stepped, to its slice of the night garden: navy, perforated stars, the elephants asleep. Flip all five for the whole night; tap any strip to flip it back.

title: The Smudge
note: A macro of her embossing: beige fibrous paper at extreme close-up, a field of small raised organic reliefs thinning toward the edges, and at the heart one faint red smudge. Raking light orbits once in forty seconds; the reliefs surface and sink as it passes. Double-tap to reseed the field; the smudge never moves, it is the anchor. Almost still, on purpose.

title: Un Jardín
note: Her 2020 creature world alive: a layered papercut garden (ferns, perforated pods, curling stems) with the black elephant and pale-blue companion anchored center-left and small Hugos blob creatures wandering the low layers. All motion is stepped stopmotion, no smooth tweening anywhere, her native grammar. Tap the paper and a new creature is cut and wanders in (up to twelve); drag to rustle the nearest layer.

title: Walk Into the Garden
note: Her tunnel book as a dolly shot: six nested cut-paper frames recede into the Los Hugos garden (ferns, perforated seed pods, a leafy arch), and deep inside, small, the black elephant and its pale-blue companion under a perforated moon. Drag up to walk in; the frames separate with true parallax and the walk ends at the moon. Tap a frame and it lifts toward you for a beat.

title: Five Scenes, One Turn
note: Her carousel book as a paper machine: five cut-paper scenes (hedgehog, bird, seed garden, moon, house) standing as panels around a center, layered edges and honest shadows between planes, pink spent only on the house roof, orange only on the bird's beak. Drag to turn it; it settles panel-forward in stepped stops. Tap a panel and it swings open a few degrees to show its layers.

title: Herringbone Garden
note: Her 2026 embossing as a light instrument: a fibrous beige sheet, a strict woven grid embossed at its center, organic leaf and teardrop reliefs orbiting it, and one faint red smudge, the only color event. Nothing is drawn as lines; the relief exists only as light and shadow while a raking light orbits slowly. Drag anywhere to take the light into your hand; release and the drift resumes.

title: Cosas de Todos los Días
note: Her register as a still life in motion (her bio line is the title: dibujos y cosas de todos los dias): six objects from her strips on a kitchen table, los vasos de Noah, las plumas de Emi, las semillas en el frasco, el crayon buscado, la hoja, la piedra, each carrying exactly one touch of her soft blue. They drift very slowly and resettle into a new constellation every twenty seconds. Nothing happens, tenderly. Tap one for its name.

title: Acá Están
note: Three panels of warmth and one quiet turn: a child is sent to find a crayon, a leaf, a stone and a belt buckle; comes back proud with a small plant; the mother crows ¡ACA ESTAN! Then the fourth panel, larger: the father, smiling, in the piece's only blue. Tap through at your own pace; when his line arrives, it arrives once. No replay. Restraint is the whole technique.

title: Sábados a la Mañana
note: Her Club de historietas: a round Saturday-morning table, five kid-invented game cards fanned around it (el juego de Ramon, lo que vio la pelota, la casa del gato...) and a shared sheet in the middle. Tap a card and its game starts with a starter drawing; draw on the sheet and your marks land in kid-yellow, the kids' color, never hers. Tap ver and everything drawn plays back. It never clears, and there is no erasing anyone: sin borrar.

title: Microhistorias Geselinas
note: Her museum thesis (Un jardin sobre el mar, 2026): Villa Gesell archived in small stories. Drag to walk the town in parallax: pine forest behind, sandy street with the historic chalet, the flowering garden in front, the sea at the end of the street. Six numbered flags mark the microhistorias (limones, un sapo, el carpintero, el chalet, el jardin, el mar); tap one to read it. The walk loops; a town you can keep walking.

title: Inesperadamente
note: Her comic-to-reality bridge: a drawn comic (berries by the door: ¡Un tesoro!; seeds in jars: las pongo aca a ver que pasa) that does not end at the punchline. Tap through and the last two panels are not drawings but stills: the seedlings real, growing in milk bags and bottles, a blue-banded butterfly on a stem. The drawn half wobbles under a drag; the real half does not move. Tap the butterfly and it flies once.

title: Dibujo para Atesorar
note: Her notebook doctrine (Dibujo mientras espero. Dibujo para atesorar): a spiral notebook open on a wooden table, a 2x2 strip half-finished inside it (mother in the blue apron, Emi with her bundle of feathers para guardar), margin notes from the waiting places: sala de espera, plaza, cafe. Every so often a new line arrives, in bursts and pauses, the rhythm of drawing between other things. The strip never finishes. That is the point.

Her kid-logic strip, verbatim: Noah, llevá las cosas de a una. Si, lo que pasa es que tengo dos manos. 1+1=2. ¡Pua! Four notebook panels; panel 1 is inked and the rest wait in pencil. Each tap inks the next panel at reading pace; there is no autoplay. The mother is the butt of the joke, never the child. Blue appears only on Noah's shirt, and only once his panels ink in.

title: 31. Mamá
note: Her numbered-vignette engine: 31 small cards, one micro-moment per day of a child's visit (1. Llegada, 2. Limones, 3. Gato, 4. Silencio: a veces no hace falta hablar), meandering in a band like notebook pages, no drama anywhere, until the last, bigger card: 31. Mama. Drag to walk the month; each centered card types its caption; tap a card to flip it and see where she drew it.

title: Caja de Remedios
note: Her drawn-on-whatever origin: the ground is not paper but a medicine box, its printed dosage ghosting through the cardboard under the urgent ink drawing (pregnant avatar, red suitcase, hospital window). Tap the corner note (caja de remedios, 2016) and the same drawing re-renders, fast, onto the next support: hospital napkin, cream tube, textbook page. Clean white canvas is not an option.

title: ¿Dónde Estar?
note: The migrant's doubt as a pendulum: Lisbon (red tram, tiled facades) on the left, Buenos Aires (cafe, wide avenue) on the right, and her small avatar with the red suitcase on a tightrope between them, the empty between-space the largest thing on the page. Drag her toward a city and it brightens while the other fades; let go and she swings back to the middle. There is no arrival state. Tap a city for her words.

title: Río y Llanto
note: Her jewel, the contradiction: one figure laughing with X-eyes while crying, a jajaja bubble on one side, a red wound on the other, a rubber duck at her feet. Drag up and humor leads, drag down and pain leads, but the opposite never disappears (the mix is clamped so neither register ever drops to zero), and tap makes her laugh and cry at full force for one beat.

title: La Velocidad del Habla
note: Her live-memory practice (dibuje memorias de quien se me siente adelante): an empty chair faces you, and each tap deposits the next fragment of a stranger's memory (la cocina de mi abuela, el rio, un perro amarillo...), drawn stroke by stroke at speech speed around the chair, phrases lettered down the left margin. The yellow dog is drawn in red: the one fragment allowed to glow. It never completes; it accumulates.

title: Manivela
note: Her hand-cranked Cinegraf: a tracing-paper film strip (phones turning into birds, after Tindergraf) runs through a drawn kraft viewer, neighbor frames ghosting at 25% through the paper. There is no play button and no autoplay, ever: drag the crank in circles and the film runs at your hand's speed, backwards if you crank backwards, dead still when you stop.

title: Yo Organizo el Caos
note: Her doctrine, verbatim: it is not chaos, it is thought, she organizes it as she wants. Tumbling figures, a bent pipe, a falling chair, a suitcase and speech scraps scattered with punk looseness over a faint architect's grid, every element exactly on its slot. Fling anything and it springs back to its place; tap the background and the grid shows itself. One red garment, plus the tiny pipe in the kraft title band.

title: Quero a Minha Mãe
note: Her repeated-figure sequencer from the Gravidez cover: eight white bodies on flat loud red, the same body redrawn eight times with the belly growing, while the bubble overhead decays (QUERO A MINHA MAE... MAE... M... ...MAE?) and comes back shouting. The first holds a pregnancy test and a SIM sign. Drag sideways to scrub the sequence; tap a figure to freeze her mid-stutter.

title: Sin Viñetas
note: Her founding doctrine: a day of domestic chaos (mother, crying baby, ringing phone, spilled coffee, open suitcase, laundry line) drawn with NO panel borders, no gutters, no boxes anywhere; the scenes flow into each other and a faint pink wash thickens where the anguish peaks. The red is spent only on the phone, the spill, and the title. Drag to smear the wash; tap a figure for its stuttered thought.

title: La Mano Dibuja Sola
note: Her doctrine: no sketches, straight to paper, the hand draws by itself. A blank sheet; each tap commits the next passage of a small crowded room (table, figures, window, plant, shelf, frames) stroke by stroke, wobble and all. There is no undo, no eraser, no restart anywhere in the piece. When it is done, it stays done. Drag to look around the paper.

title: Festejan las Gallinas
note: Direct from her 2026 embroidery: the three chickens celebrate on dusty-rose cloth, magenta in the center, turquoise stars stitched above, pecking in turn at the scattered seed-stitches in a seamless loop. The colophon along the bottom carries the real date of the day you open it, Rosario. Tap the colophon to re-stitch it; drag for parallax.

title: Más Íntimo Que la Ropa Interior
note: Her claim as a piece: looking through someone's library is more intimate than their underwear drawer. A tall shelf in color bands (reds, blues, yellows, greens, neutrals), and every one of the eighty-odd spines is a tiny invented book cover, generated, none repeated, no real titles. Drag a book out to see its cover; tap to hold it out; tap again to reshelve.

title: Qué Desorden
note: Some people see a full table and think what a mess; she uses it as inspiration. An empty tabletop and her handwritten checklist down the margin (la taza, los libros, la naranja, las tijeras, la planta, las llaves, el cuaderno, el lapiz, las gafas). Each tap draws the next thing stroke by stroke with its label and ticks its box. Drag any item to nudge the clutter.

title: Ahora el Caballo
note: Her promotion mechanism: a crowded muted plaza in gouache, dozens of tiny figures, and small in the background one blue horse. Tap the horse and the whole scene re-composes around it in embroidered folk register: applique, running stitch, neon mane, striped cloth, its own stitched colophon with the real date. Tap again and it goes back to being a detail.

title: Manet Duerme la Siesta
note: A tiny moment, watch-only: Manet asleep on a green sofa in a big quiet room, his finished canvas leaning against the wall beside him, night at the window, a lamp glowing, a cat asleep on the rug. His chest breathes slowly; the cat's tail flicks once per loop; nobody wakes him. Drag for a slight parallax.

title: Se Cayó Colgando el Matisse
note: A museum calamity on a loop: a tiny forged Matisse (an homage, not a copy) hangs center wall while a small worker on a wobbling ladder tries to straighten it. Once per loop he falls, the picture tilts, the two tiny onlookers flinch, and a guard calmly walks in and re-hangs everything. Deadpan throughout. Drag the ladder to wobble it harder.

title: Miércoles 28 de Mayo
note: Her textile register: three applique chickens on dusty-rose cloth (magenta in the center, two pale blue-gray flankers), running-stitch outlines, turquoise stars, yellow seed-stitches scattered where the beaks point. Along the bottom, slightly crooked, the stitched colophon: the real weekday and date of the day you open it, and Rosario. Tap the colophon and it re-stitches itself; drag for a gentle parallax.

title: El Río
note: One eternal blue hour on a wide river, watch-only: a woman submerged to the shoulders, a crocodile, a snake, a bat hanging upside down holding a pink heart, a fox wading by distant polite flames, and a crescent moon with a red droplet. Everything weeps; nothing is explained. Tears fall in one seamless loop and the bat sways. Drag to pan across the panorama.

title: La Sociedad del Cansancio, Leída por Cato
note: Byung-Chul Han, read by a cat and its tail: four panels. Cato sleeps on the book; a black bird crosses the frame shouting the thesis (LA VIOLENCIA DE LA DESTRUCCIÓN SUAVE); Cato stares into the phone while his tail watches with pink eyes; finally he lies sunk under BEEP BEEP BEEP, thinking PREFERIRÍA NO HACERLO. The tail is its own character throughout. Tap through; drag down on the last panel and the notifications pile up.

title: Tengo Gripe
note: A gouache in full sunny color: she sits at the yellow table with red radiating stripes, crying heavily, phone in hand, while the open sketchbook in front of her cries back (a red heart on one page, two green eyes on the other). The caption is deadpan: No estoy llorando, tengo gripe. Tap the sketchbook to swap which page cries harder; drag on the window to slide the balcony from morning to dusk.

title: Inventario de Mi Vida
note: Her inventory method, performed: a handwritten checklist (el piso, las paredes, la cama, la mesa, la planta, la ventana, el gato, mi ropa, mis zapatos) and an empty page. Each tap draws the next thing stroke by stroke, shadow first, label last, and ticks its box. When the room is complete it breathes: the curtain sways, the cat's tail flicks. Drag any furnishing to move it.

title: Mi Madre
note: Domestic magic realism, watch-only: mother on her yellow leopard-print sofa with a red mug, floral dress, patchwork pillows, while a large green crocodile descends the striped staircase behind her, one step at a time, forever. Nobody reacts. The painted eye in the mirror blinks. Drag for a slight parallax shift.

title: La Amarilla
note: Seven memory chapters, each one a bicycle: the yellow one (the only bike in color), the stolen one (a ghost and a cut lock), the borrowed, the childhood one, the one from the red-sweater chapter. The chapters drift out of order, dissolving in grey wash, and nothing is explained: the object carries the memory. Tap to drift on; drag a bike to turn it.

title: Soy Otra
note: Her rule as a piece: CADA VEZ QUE ME DIBUJO SOY OTRA. A seated self-portrait in strict black and white that redraws itself stroke by stroke every time you tap: new hair, new tattoos, a septum ring, a flower earring, a different gaze, never the same face twice in a row. Drag on the hair and it grows.

title: Una Libreta de Salas de Espera
note: A waiting-room notebook as a piece: one long ink leporello of strangers in plastic chairs, an old man with his newspaper (Retiro 14:20), a child asleep on a bag (se durmio), a nurse's shoes passing. Thin line, no shading, grey only on the chairs. Drag to scroll the strip; tap a vignette to lift it and read its annotation card.

title: Solterona
note: Five panels and a caption card reclaiming the spinster: a sea creature shouts Tia at the silver-haired aunt on the sunset beach; indoors, a child relays two podcast bros explaining that women over 30 have no options and asks if she agrees. She says nothing, and the nothing is the whole piece. Tap their quotes to mute them; drag the sun down to loop back to the beach.

title: Él Es Así
note: A ten-panel dark carousel: at the party, her boyfriend is in the corner eating dirt, which only means he wants to go home, says his girlfriend. Six months later, at her door, the real story comes out flat and factual, and the friend is accused of being the toxic one. Final panel: the corner, the dirt, the same pose. Tap through; drag the dirt and it never runs out.

title: Hazlo Como en Francia
note: A six-panel housing-crisis carousel in two columns: on the left, her reasoned guide to fighting for your rights (SOCIMI injustice, evictions, anti-monopoly law); on the right, his answers, which are only insults about her armpits, her patchouli, her hemp pants. Then France, 1936: outrage over a 2.10 baguette, then the same man beaming at a guillotine. Tap the blade and the baguette halves.

title: Amiga, Date Cuenta
note: A five-slide carousel: the dog-woman pleads silently that it not be Scott, misreads his dilated pupils as love (it is not love, says her friend; it is the weekend), and the tribunal banner slams down: BEWARE, Scott the Scrotum. Tap to advance; tap Scott's face to toggle the pupils; drag on her and the tail wags in denial.

title: ¿Para Qué Quiere Los Dientes?
note: The es-un-diez-pero card game at a party table: four players, blank cards held to their foreheads, clues escalating from the festival guy to the man with no teeth at all. Tap a player to flip a card (it stays blank); tap the footer for another zinger; drag to deal and escalate.

title: Hay Que Cerrar el Hociquito
note: A four-panel date in cinema darkness: he likes movies that leave you thinking for days; she hears traumatic Todd Solondz films. Then the name-dropping, the diagrams for Interstellar, and one giant yellow monologue bubble that bursts the frame. Drag inside it to read the whole rant. She leaves anyway.

title: Hombre de Alto Valor
note: A ten-panel black-and-white carousel: Pacheco, high-value man, flexes bigger and shouts louder every panel (the Matrix, the gym every day, dying in a ditch like a man) until one dark panel where he sits small and alone in a JUST DOO DOO shirt. Tap to inflate him; drag down at the peak and he collapses.

title: O Xa Chegou
note: A seven-panel carousel: a glossy foodie influencer vlogs a traditional tavern packed with locals, totally off-guidebook, in alternating color and black-and-white panels, until she finally asks the heavy-lidded owner for the menu and he delivers one huge word: NADA. Tap to advance; drag on the last panel and the review stars fall.

title: Mundo Diminuto
note: Pineápolis, a toy-scale riso city: radiating streets around a star plaza, a pink tram circling, a hairdresser frog giving tiny haircuts, and a caped vampire floating between rooftops. Drag to pan the miniature world; tap the frog or the vampire.

title: Souvenirs del Viajero Experto
note: A nine-panel taxonomy of tacky souvenirs catalogued by a blue rodent traveler: a collar of tiny hands, a Paris Mon Amour tee, a stopped starfish heist, a Benidorm tattoo applied through tears, fridge magnets as capital-A art, nostalgic trash, a burning chipotle sauce, and one involuntary lizard. Drag his suitcase open and the lizard moves in.

title: Un Poco de Costumbrismo
note: Ten panels of millennial domestic ritual: the 200-degree Khaleesi bath, the half-eaten Tanjiro cake, the can of fake scenario soda, nachos and cartoons (planazo), the DOJA hoodie crisis, the manga stack unread since 2019, crying to Rosalía, and Evangelion over fries and fried eggs. Tap a panel to see it large.

title: Es Aquí
note: Satanás keeps a reserved seat for people who call you crazy for no reason: a jolly red devil presents a black spiked chair oozing red, beside a cobra and a skull, in flat flickering flames. Tap the chair, the snake, or the skull.

title: El Piropo del Siglo XXI
note: Two deadpan orange monkeys on a black branch in a grey hatched jungle trade the compliments of the century, starting with how great you look in the head. Watch the bubble change its mind every few seconds; the monkeys never smile.

title: Sin Mi Ayuda Estarías Perdido
note: Señor Sabenada, the yellow know-it-all, in four panels: he waves hello and admits he never understood your job, raises a finger in the jungle to advise you anyway, winks that without him you would be lost, baby, and waves goodbye. Drag and his pointing finger follows you; tap to rotate the panels.

title: Mugre Debajo del Sofá
note: Her dust gang as a sitcom cast: a stitched-eye mouse, a peace-signing bug, an alien with a Q-tip, a winged insect, a muscular lizard, and a winking cat, first in lineup, then in a moonlit alley, then in a bar run by a many-armed cockroach. Tap a member for its signature bit; tap the bartender for another round.

title: Loco Pimiento
note: A six-panel gag page starring a furious green bell-pepper office worker: mopping a flooded office, breaking the company computer, terrifying his eggplant, carrot, and radish coworkers. Nobody dares fire him, because he is cracked. Tap a panel to escalate his anger; drag to shake the page.

title: What Happens Next
note: A flat homage to a classic painting sits framed and untouched while her characters invade its margins: a black cat from the left, a pink rabbit from the right, a tiny smoking door on the frame, a smiley balloon rising below. Tap for a new painting and a new invasion.

title: Horse, Rabbit, Ghost, Smoke
note: Her four symbols walk in procession: the horse strides tall, the rabbit hops drooling and its drips flip black blobs white, the ghost floats smoking and smiling, and smoke trails behind them all as a thick white ribbon. Drag to stir a gust.

title: Six Views
note: One street seen six ways: pink panels of a reader, a dog, a bench smoker, a kid with a balloon, a couple arguing in punctuation, a pigeon close-up, arranged around one tall blue civic tower on yellow. Watch one panel change every few seconds.

title: Where the Smile Isn't
note: Twelve neon objects on black, and exactly three yellow smileys hiding where faces are not: on a kebab, on a radio dial, under a palm crown. Tap to move them.

title: The Held Thing
note: A white profile with a black bob against black-leaf wallpaper crawling over vermilion, one hand holding a tiny decorated cup with smoke curling from it. Watch the wallpaper crawl.

title: Door, Three States
note: Dark domes and hills roll across a yellow ground, each holding one tiny door: closed blue, open and glowing orange, or pouring white smoke. Tap a door to cycle it; drag for wind.

title: Nine Small Dooms
note: A giant black cat with yellow slit eyes presides over seven vignette circles: a parrot and a ghost, a palm tree, a crouched smoker, a duck with flame eyes, a smiley kebab, a smoking door, a closed door. Watch them drift.

title: Host
note: A giant yellow face whose eyes are a red rabbit and a red horse, blue tears falling past tiny drifting ghosts, a small black Satan sitting on the red lips. Drag, and the occupants follow your gaze.

title: Breaking Point
note: Twelve large symbol-faces stay blank and calm until you tap one: brows slash in, a forehead vein ticks, the face darkens a step, then it exhales back to blank. Tap a face.

title: Shadow Pools
note: Five small pink objects, a bottle, a cup, a shoe, a book, a chair, on a dusty blue ground, each trailing an enormous hard black shadow pool. Watch the unseen light orbit and the shadows swing.

title: Four Passes
note: A night bar scene in bare line art: a woman raising a glass, figures at the bar, hanging lamps, shelves of bottles. Drag to scrub through the artist's four passes: line, black fills, flat color, light.

title: Object Icons
note: Six object icons, a record, two dice, a radio, a cup, a key, a plant, each in its own black shadow pool on alternating blue and terracotta. Watch for the one that turns to night.

title: Pink Mass
note: Forty-one identical blank pink figures breathe as one mass, a single gray figure swaying out of sync among them. Drag to disturb them: they lean, they do not scatter.

title: Half-Shadow
note: Three huge mask-faces split by a hard vertical shadow loom over a mint street with three yellow stray dogs. Drag to slide the shadow from morning to evening.

title: Silent Nine
note: Nine deadpan panels of tiny office rituals, the speech balloons holding only punctuation: ..., ?, !, ... Tap to generate a new silent story.

title: Gray Outsider
note: An enormous gray head with a symbol face looms over a miniature office where twelve identical pink workers type in perfect sync. Drag, and its gaze slowly follows you.

title: Interior Stories
note: Six quiet comic panels: a cat asleep on books, a reader by a rainy window, two steaming cups, a hallway dog, a bedroom poster, hands holding a tiny zine. Tap a panel to play its moment.

title: Grandfather's Garden
note: A garden at snail scale: giant leaves arch overhead, five patterned snails glide along the veins leaving silver trails, and one tiny watering can waits in the distance. Watch for the falling dewdrop.

title: Bad Reputation
note: The fairy-tale lie: a giant snarling wolf looms over a tiny red hood under a blood-red moon. Drag to wipe it away and find the calm wolf trotting with her pack, with three small facts below.

title: Arcadia
note: Three inks only: a tiny swimmer waves from terracotta rocks under a bold round tree, facing a calm blue sea and a big empty sky. Watch for the falling leaf.

title: Forest Census
note: A field-guide plate of twelve distinct mushrooms, every fourth one drawn as a hatched ink study with a Latin label. Watch the spores drift.

title: Cabinet of Curiosities
note: A 4 by 4 cabinet of flat-color doodads around a hand-lettered WUNDERZINES title. Tap an object and it plays: the boot kicks, the teapot pours, the clock spins.

title: The Bewitched Witch
note: A kind witch sits side-saddle on a giant spotted mushroom, her bird, rabbit, hedgehog and fox around her, a glowing pumpkin house below and a strip of six mushrooms underneath. Watch the fireflies drift.

title: Ant Atlas
note: A giant friendly red ant among oversized flat flowers, ringed by five diagram cards: a soldier, a leaf-cutter, a marching column, two tiny riders, a size chart. Watch the antennae wave.

title: Hortus
note: A walled garden of giant frogs around a red tree, and a woman whose pet frog keeps flicking its tongue at her nose. Drag to scatter the frogs.

title: Fire Circle
note: Eight masked specters in electric blue and violet dance around a tall flame while faces form and dissolve in the smoke. Watch the fire.

title: Two Riders
note: Twin archways in a pink marble frame: a rider on a yellow horse under a pink sun, a rider on a pink horse under a crescent moon. Watch the sun sink as the moon rises.

title: Saints and Suns
note: A quilt of gold-edged diamonds, a haloed saint on checkerboard in each, blue suns in the gaps. Tap to reshuffle the quilt.

title: Lantern Hill
note: Seventeen dancers in red and yellow move on a green hill under a string of glowing lanterns. Drag to stir a breeze.

title: Two Heads, One Flower
note: Two mirrored heads crowned with flame-flowers, lips almost touching. Drag to lean them toward each other.

title: Night Panther
note: A mirrored roaring panther poster on flat red: yellow ring eyes, blue muzzle, white fangs and whiskers. Watch it breathe.

title: Oblong Tiger
note: A giant red tiger with lime stripes and smiley faces for eyes, its coiled tail cradling a moon-egg under three night arches. Watch the tail sway.

title: Città Blocks
note: A fauvist block city crossed by rainbow ribbons, one tiny black figure walking a ledge. Watch the layers drift.

title: Letter Garden
note: Nine giant crayon letters grow like a garden, a tiny creature perched on the tallest. Drag the letters around.

title: Bus of Faces
note: A yellow bus lettered ZUVIK rolls forever, a different tiny face in every window. Touch a window and its face leans out.

title: Balloon Belly
note: A tiny mother holds a balloon the size of a belly while a giant orange face grins in from the other half of the frame. Drag the balloon.

title: Giant on a Minipony
note: A giant-headed woman in a striped dress riding a pony a quarter her size, inside a blue painted frame. Watch them amble.

title: Lunar Cat
note: A giant ochre cat whose body is a field of asterisk stars, under a black sky of bigger drifting stars. Watch the stars pulse.

title: The Type Is the Face
note: Hand-drawn letters in concentric blue line-work form a face inside a cream scalloped cloud. Drag the letters.

title: Island of Small Things
note: A giant black island stuffed with tiny bottles, cups and stars, three cream creatures riding its top, under a hand-lettered invented phrase. Watch the motifs drift.

title: Overlapping Runners
note: Two runners built from overlapping transparent color washes, striding down a giant blue slash. Watch the washes shimmer.

title: Minotauro
note: A huge black minotaur in three riso inks, wearing hot-pink boots and clutching a white envelope purse. Watch it breathe and snort.

title: Evasion
note: A woman crouched behind orange-red bars, a tiny key held in her mouth. Drag to part the bars.

title: Bear Page
note: A giant blue bear whose belly is a newspaper page, waving one white paw. Watch it breathe.

title: Microshift Strips
note: Seven vertical strips of a fragmented workday, each with its own tiny motion; the office worker is line-work in the middle. Watch the vignettes swap.

title: Goal Ball
note: A soccer ball with a face and boot legs, while two giant hands hover at the corners, never quite reaching it. Watch it bob.

title: Pasta Monster
note: A mountain of writhing pasta with a toothy grin, and one very small waiter with his arms up. Watch the strands writhe.

title: Cracking Monument
note: A colossal marble figure on a newspaper plinth, cracking apart over an orange grid floor; a fallen fragment crushes a bicycle wheel. Watch the cracks creep.

title: Mural Cats
note: A painted wall of bold outline cats, clouds and yarn balls; three cats wear flat color. Drag a cat and watch it swing back.

title: Snowfall Report
note: A skater seen from below, tricolor flag overhead, big outlined snowflakes turning slowly around her. Watch the flag ripple.

title: Portrait Inset
note: A winter scene split white and turquoise, with a dotted mustard portrait circle straddling the diagonal. Drag the inset; its eyes follow you.

title: Every Surface Patterned
note: A room where every surface carries its own pattern: sofa, rug, lamp, laptop, cat and all. Watch the cat's tail swish.

title: Letter Sprinkle
note: Pink cliffs, striped birch trunks, teal water, and tiny letters sprinkled only inside the foliage and the waves. Watch the water drift.

title: Eye Threads
note: Seven walkers cross diagonal stripes on indigo, their eyes linked by dashed threads in three colors. Watch them step and blink.

title: Slash Races
note: Green and red halves split by a thick white slash; two racers in blue ride it down. Drag to yank the slash.

title: Tricolor Panels
note: Three tricolor panels down the left, each with a mini scene and an outline name; a blue speed skater crosses the rest. Watch the dots shimmer.

title: Sign Painter
note: A hand-painted shop sign: wonky cream serif on deep green inside a gold keyline, lit by a slow passing light. Watch.

title: Palm Tones
note: Flat palm glyphs and star dots on near-black, one of five printed colorways. Watch them sway; tap to change colorway.

title: Edge Type
note: A wine label system: condensed white caps run up the left edge over a slow weave of translucent ribbons on indigo. Watch the ribbons reweave.

title: Corrupt Lines
note: Stacked serif trade words on black; now and then a letter melts into an ink swirl, then the lines heal. Watch.

title: Exploded Serif
note: A giant serif capital pulled apart along its axes like a technical diagram. Drag the fragments; double-tap for a new letter.

title: Smoke Word
note: One word as a chunky tube of smoke, its letters read through black counters. Watch it morph; tap for the next word.

title: Fraktur Field
note: Dense white blackletter glyphs interlocking on black, bleeding off the edges. Drag to disturb the field.

title: Script Ground
note: An invented word in white brush script on burnt orange, redrawn stroke by stroke forever. Watch it repaint.

title: Memory Wall
note: A dark teal wall that collects memory glyphs. Tap to plant one; every twelve grows the scallop band along the bottom.

title: Literal Idiom
note: An amphora wearing the idiom literally: footprints stride around its belly under the words CON I PIEDI. Tap for a new pairing.

title: Selva
note: A burnt-orange Dante profile in laurel, ringed by sage foliage and halftone dots inside a zigzag border. Tap for a new profile.

title: Novilunio
note: Three coral figures recline under giant fronds on a teal night, framed mini-scenes floating above. Watch the moon glow.

title: The Embrace
note: Two figures embrace under foliage while hat figures sway and a crescent moon glows. Watch them breathe.

title: Scallop Trim
note: A scallop band in lavender and rust trims a dark wall, botanical glyphs peeking above. Drag to scroll the frieze.

title: Blue Garden
note: An underwater garden in arched niches: orange-red corals, vases and striped fish on deep blue. Watch the fish drift.

title: Panel Wall
note: A mural facade of framed panels: figures, coral glyphs, lettering marks and patterns in mustard, teal and rust. Watch the motifs crossfade.

title: Calla Dive
note: A diver in a red cap arcs into a giant calla lily on still water, and the petals close over her. Watch the held breath.

title: Loupe Snow
note: A magnifier rests on a grey-blue field; snowflakes inside its lens grow large, and a stream pours from its rim. Drag the loupe.

title: Outrage
note: Black domino slabs stamped with yellow thumbs-downs fall in a steady column and topple into a pile. Watch the metronome.

title: Fire, Rain
note: One figure wears raindrops, the other flames. Drag them together and their patterns bleed into each other.

title: Moving Toward
note: Two golden grass blades bend toward each other; two ladybugs climb to meet once per loop. Watch for the meeting.

title: The Capsule
note: A woman sits curled inside a giant red-and-white capsule. Drag to tilt it; she slides gently to the low end.

title: Roofwalker
note: A woman stands barefoot on the roof of a doll-scale house under an enormous sky. Watch the clouds drift.

title: The Knot
note: A calm woman stands inside a towering knot of thorny stems and red roses. Drag outward to loosen it, inward to tighten.

title: Chosen Picture
note: A wall of tiny blue cars, one framed bicycle picture, a chair. Drag the frame and the pattern bends away.

title: Moon Reader
note: An astronaut sits on the moon's curve reading a small red book under a bright Earth. Watch a page turn.

title: Yellow Wall
note: A man on a tall ladder, painting a white wall yellow. Drag to paint; the wall keeps every stroke.

title: Blackout
note: A red fist rises from cracked earth under a black skyline, holds, and sinks again. Watch the three acts.

title: One White Sheep
note: One white sheep ringed by black sheep, all facing in. Drag the white one and the ring follows.

title: Morning Abduction
note: A flying saucer beams up the most Italian object in the universe. Watch it bob; drag to nudge the saucer.

title: Expectations
note: A mountain of squeezed orange halves for one finger of juice. Drag to squeeze another; the glass stays nearly empty.

title: Starfisher
note: A child on a dark horizon holds an absurdly long pole, its little net hovering under one bright star. Watch it sway.

title: The Path
note: A two-panel pilgrimage: a lone walker follows a winding path to a distant white church. Drag to move the walker. Tap to reseed the route.

title: Pink Manager
note: A one-panel portrait generator in magenta-skin grammar, tonal first, colorway second. Tap to reseed the pose and colorway. Drag to nudge the head.

title: Summit Loop
note: A golden-hour loop: four mountain bands drift at their own speeds, two tiny hikers stand on the trail, a bird crosses every twenty seconds. Watch.

title: Red Dress
note: A film-noir poster loop: blind light drifts across a deep blue interior, the phone rings once, and the red dress holds. Tap to change the accent.

title: Door Policy
note: One glowing doorway in a dark surround, a warm office inside. Drag the door. Tap to reseed the office.

title: Headcount
note: A suited manager sprouts his own stretched heads like petals. Drag to sprout more. Double-tap to reseed.

title: Quoted
note: His eyes are quotation marks, and every blink swaps the punctuation. Drag the quotes. Tap for a new pair.

title: Sitter's Ghost
note: A desk whose cabriole legs belong to an invisible sitter; the red lamp breathes. Drag to stir the sitter.

title: Multispecies Square
note: A green city square where geese, a piglet, stilt kids and a jogger share one light. Drag to stir the square.

title: Rogue Cover
note: A magazine-cover satire: an ordinary person, an unexpected animal, a giant masthead. Tap to publish a new issue.

title: Pattern Facade
note: A blue swirl-patterned facade under an apricot sun, ghosts passing before it. Drag to pan across the facade.

title: Glitch Pastoral
note: A quiet sepia valley under a rust sun, torn briefly by glitch bands that always heal. Watch for the glitch storms.

title: Mucha Siren
note: An art-nouveau siren whose ribbon hair never stops moving. Tap for a new title word and gown.

title: Belleville Metro
note: A metro station grown into a garden of books, baskets and hanging plants. Tap for a new station.

title: The Big Disc
note: One huge flat disc hangs over a quiet city edge, breathing through three skies. Watch the disc breathe.

title: Solarpunk Haussmann
note: A carless Paris street where ivy grows over Haussmann stone. Drag to plant seeds along your path.

title: Paper Palace
note: A small house on still water, under one giant billowing red cloth. Drag for a breeze.

title: Radiant Still Life
note: A cocktail glass glows amid dashed rays and drifting orbs, watched by one calm eye. Drag to stir the orbs.

title: Jewel Beast
note: A serious blue animal wears one oversized jewel, quite deliberately. Drag to orbit the light; double-tap for a new animal and jewel.

title: Word Shadow
note: A glossy lemon stands before a wall made of its own name. Drag to slide the word; double-tap for a new word and subject.

title: The Gilded Object
note: A calm botanical tarot, one gilded object to a card. Tap to deal the next card; drag to fan the last three.

title: Echo Chamber
note: A hand reaches for its own reflection in a gilt mirror, and the reflection is gently wrong. Drag to move the hand; double-tap to change what the reflection holds.

title: Mountain of Stools
note: Giant stools stand on a rocky summit like mountains, two tiny figures between their legs. Drag to drift the sky.

title: Pomegranate Crown
note: One glossy pomegranate split open on deep indigo, its light forever travelling. Drag to move the light around the fruit; double-tap for another fruit.

title: Abstract Fruits
note: After Angelina Bambina's abstract fruits: four seamless fruit patterns in a grid - leaves on mustard, pomegranates in teal and pink, pomegranates on soft pink, speckled dots on gray - each tile breathing gently while its colours rotate through the harvest schemes. Tap to re-seed the patterns. Tap to re-seed.

title: The Fox Wears the Lights
note: After Angelina Bambina's fox in the lights: a woman in a knitted beanie cradles a white fox whose tail is wrapped in festive lights that chase along it, snow drifting, her breath fogging in the cold. Double-tap to re-order the lights. Double-tap to re-order.

title: Five Women, One Pink Ground
note: After Angelina Bambina's five women: five busts in a half-ring on a flowered pink ground, every woman in her own pattern, swaying on her own rhythm while a beaded necklace swings. Tap to bring the next woman forward. Tap to rotate the ring.

title: Picnic From Above
note: After Angelina Bambina's picnic from above: a checkered blanket laid with melon, baguette, wine and a straw hat, a dog asleep in the corner, and three friends present only as arms reaching in. Drag to slide the picnic; double-tap lays it again. Drag to slide, double-tap to re-lay.

title: Dive Repeat
note: After Angelina Bambina's dive repeat: a seamless teal pattern of women swimming, every figure different, coral and seaweed between them, folded over a beach towel below. Drag to scroll the pattern forever; double-tap changes the product. Drag to scroll, double-tap to switch.

title: Cardigan Season
note: After Angelina Bambina's cardigan season: a white-haired woman in an olive knit sips from a yellow mug at a dark table, a leaf-sketched book and a lattice pie beside her, autumn leaves drifting down one at a time. Watch her sip. Double-tap to re-lay the table.

title: Three Things in a Pocket
note: After Angelina Bambina's three things in a pocket: a woman walks her reindeer across a star-sprinkled ground, shopping bags in hand, a candy-cane stripe on her coat hem. Drag sideways to change her outfit, up or down to change the animal, tap for a whole new trio. Drag to swap, tap to re-deal.

title: Hair That Becomes a World
note: After Angelina Bambina's hair that becomes a world: her white hair rises and turns into a snowy miniature landscape of houses, pines and deer under a smiling crescent moon, while she reads below in a red zigzag sweater. Snow falls only inside the hair. Double-tap for a new landscape. Double-tap to re-lay the hills.

title: Magical Holidays Rink
note: After Yael Hofri's magical holidays rink: four skaters gliding hand-in-hand around a moonlit rink, trails fading behind their blades, a lit tree, toy stalls and string lights twinkling over the snow. Drag and a breeze moves their scarves. Drag for a breeze.

title: First Light
note: After Yael Hofri's first light: a brass menorah on deep indigo, its nine candles lighting one by one, each flame blooming a small warm halo, then all swaying together before the ceremony begins again. Double-tap to replay the lighting. Double-tap to replay.

title: Golden City
note: After Yael Hofri's golden city: a postcard square at noon, statue column, red roofs and green domes under one big sun, six tiny strollers on the plaza, one with a teddy bear, a camera flashing now and then, birds crossing. Drag and the square shifts in depth. Drag to look around.

title: Vintage Hobby Room
note: After Yael Hofri's vintage hobby room: a woman reading on a magenta rug, a cream cat batting an orange yarn ball, a mint record player spinning in the corner, steam rising off a blue mug. Drag and the vinyl spins faster; double-tap re-lays the room. Drag to spin, double-tap to re-lay.

title: Leaf Picnic
note: After Yael Hofri's leaf picnic: four hands of three skin tones share a lattice pie on a pink checked blanket, coffee pouring into a blue mug while fall leaves tumble past. Double-tap and the pie becomes cake, a bread basket, a fruit bowl. Double-tap for another dish.

title: Self-Care Waltz
note: After Yael Hofri's self-care waltz: a woman dancing barefoot at night in pink headphones, wine glass raised, music notes rising, two cats asleep on the rug in the lamplight. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Golden Sun
note: After Yael Hofri's golden sun: one huge flat sun turning slowly over a balcony, a woman in pink watering her terracotta pots, leaves trailing in from the corner. Drag and the air stirs through the leaves. Drag to stir the air.

title: Long Lunch
note: After Yael Hofri's long lunch: a red and pink checkered cloth laid with a bottle of VINO, two glasses of red wine, salad, lemons, papaya, a vase of flowers and one lit candle against the leaves. Double-tap and the table is laid again, another way. Double-tap to re-lay the table.

title: Mood Boosters
note: After Kitty O'Rourke's Mood Boosters for May: four little calendar joys, a sunglassed sun over brighter days are coming, pockets full of flowers, a beach day with a dripping ice cream, and a polka-dot umbrella twirling through April showers. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Science of Bliss
note: After Kitty O'Rourke's Science of Bliss: a woman meditating on soft lavender under pink hand-lettering while email badges, to-do scraps and a BUY ME button orbit her head, a dopamine molecule of smiley faces floating by. Drag through the clutter and it dissolves into sparkles. Drag to clear the noise.

title: Fruit Fashion
note: After Kitty O'Rourke's fruit fashion: a woman in a watermelon bucket hat holding a pear stamped FRESH, then an afro and lemon-print dress, then banana earrings and a toucan balanced on a fruit stack. Tap and the next look slides in. Tap for the next character.

title: DOGUE

title: Mahjong Babies
note: After Kitty O'Rourke's Mahjong for Babies: twelve chunky tiles on cream, smiling suns, bamboo, blooms, cloud winds and toucan jokers, every one with the same two-dot smile under a banner that says it's time to play. Tap a tile and it bounces, blinks and sparkles. Tap a tile.

title: Funk My Life
note: After Kitty O'Rourke's funk poster: a woman with a huge afro and flower earrings, chin up inside a pink gig-poster frame on dark plum, FUNK MY LIFE arching over her in hand-lettered caps that groove slowly while her earrings swing and the stars twinkle. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Daydreamers
note: After Kitty O'Rourke's Daydreamers: four portraits in a grid, beach, safari, spa and ski dreaming inside their sunglasses, waves lapping and snow falling in miniature. Tap a portrait and its lenses re-dream to the next scene. Tap a portrait.

title: Scooter Girl
note: After Kitty O'Rourke's first scooter girl: a woman pushing off on a kick-scooter over mustard, daisy tee, purple patterned pants, a net bag spilling flowers, her spotted dachshund trotting at the front wheel. Drag and the whole scene rolls. Drag to roll.

title: Neon Shoe
note: After Yeti Iglesias's Vans maximalism: a giant white sneaker on a checkerboard floor under a hot pink sky, neon leaves, five watching eyes on stems, a watermelon slice, a huge pencil, and a black cat in headphones on the toe, phone flickering. Drag and the diorama pans. Drag to pan.

title: Pattern Walker
note: After Yeti Iglesias's pattern-stacked walker: a girl mid-stride on peachy cream in an orange polka-dot top and olive pants with pink stripes, a scalloped tote with a cat face bouncing at her shoulder, a pink mushroom book in her hands, autumn leaves falling around her. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Sax Bouquet
note: After Yeti Iglesias's metamorphosis: a girl in a red polka-dot dress playing saxophone on flat pink, her waist melting into stems while the bell bursts into a bouquet of cat heads, two-tone flowers and leaves that slowly blooms and relaxes as note-petals drift up. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Eat Your Colors
note: After Yeti Iglesias's Eat Your Colors: six giant vegetables on flat orange, each split into two clashing tones, eggplant, carrot, garlic, pepper, zucchini and celery, breathing slowly while one at a time does a small wiggle under twinkling sparkles. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Tuesday Funtivity
note: After Yeti Iglesias's Tuesday Funtivity: her orange cat with sparkle eyes and a green dotted scarf, sitting in a gold-latticed leaf bag beside a big pumpkin on hot pink, autumn leaves falling through starbursts. Drag and a gust streams through the leaves. Drag to gust.

title: Coffee Cats
note: After Yeti Iglesias's black coffee cats: a giant two-tone cup on cream, four black cats with yellow eyes emerging from the coffee while purple steam curls and orbs drift. Tap the cup and they dip with a splash, ripple the coffee and bob back up. Tap the cup.

title: Cat Window
note: After Yeti Iglesias's Golden Sun: an arched window on deep olive, a huge stippled orange sun in the arch, and on the checkered sill an orange striped cat flicking its tail beside a green planter and a red polka-dot mug breathing steam. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Sleeve
note: After Nina Clausonet's packaging: a tall navy sleeve tossed with coral tulips, cream stars, wheat and little women, its title band in flat geometric letters, a few motifs escaped into the cream margin and drifting up like seeds. Drag to turn the sleeve, double-tap for a new scatter. Drag to rotate, double-tap to re-scatter.

title: Edition Engine
note: After Nina Clausonet's challenge engine: a living announcement poster in her style, the muse in the header, the prompt rows, the rules and the host dots below, redesigning itself by season from September's cozy prompts to December's costume triples to July's masters. Double-tap to turn the season, drag to scroll the rows. Double-tap for the next season.

title: Bear Hug
note: After Nina Clausonet's 2020 seed: her muse hugging a huge cream polar bear on blush, both in red, her paper crown tilted, a brown tree behind them, as they rock gently together in the falling snow and the bear's ear twitches once a turn. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Pink Water
note: After Nina Clausonet's Monet homage: her muse standing in pink water, flat pink and purple lily pads on dark teal, hot-pink dress, teal umbrella high, hair and scarf streaming behind her under a pink sky. A single white petal crosses now and then. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Morning Book
note: After Nina Clausonet's morning book: her muse in a halo of white hair shaped like a heart, holding a small dark-red book as cosmos flowers grow out of its pages, one quiet line fading as it opens: hope is a quiet morning. Tap the book and the flowers open another stage. Tap the book.

title: Costume Triple
note: After Nina Clausonet's costume resolution: her muse dressed by the prompt dice, the animal worn as a print, the thing worn as a prop, opening on the jaguar turtleneck and the giant fuchsia bow. Double-tap to deal her a new costume, drag to tilt the portrait. Double-tap to deal again.

title: Shrine
note: After Nina Clausonet's body-as-landscape: her muse in profile on deep navy, her shawl a purple mountain night holding a tiny manger, palms and a winding path under an eight-point star that breathes light at her sternum. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Hair River
note: After Nina Clausonet's hair river: her white-haired muse in profile on textured gold, her hair leaving her head as a broad white river carrying three teal birds, golden leaves and white petals across the frame, a flat sunburst behind her. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Snow Cello
note: After Anna Galitskaya's winter leopard: a leopard in a snowy clearing at night, bowing a cello while the snow falls and small gold notes lift off the strings and fade. Watch only. Watch only.

title: The Fox Lady
note: After Anna Galitskaya's Fellow Fox: one fox, six professions, librarian among the book spines, baker, astronomer, gardener, cellist, ice-skater, each scene assembling around her as she walks in. Double-tap to send her off to the next job. Double-tap to change scene.

title: Five Hundred Pieces
note: After Anna Galitskaya's puzzle pipeline: a sundae garden with a cat asleep on a waffle, cut into seventy jigsaw pieces that start scattered and click home in a ripple from the centre. Drag to burst it apart, double-tap to scatter it again. Drag to scatter, double-tap to re-scatter.

title: Mushroom Hat Parade
note: After Anna Galitskaya's costume parade: six animals marching across the dark in their one big costume piece, a kitten under a mushroom cap, an elephant in a star tutu, a frog hat, a poncho, a cello carried like a banner, neon flat on near-black. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Nine Cats
note: After Anna Galitskaya's cat contact sheet: eight cats in costume around her wordmark, a gardener in overalls, a scholar with telescope, a frog hat on a watermelon, a knitted cactus hugged close, all breathing softly in their cells. Tap a cat to recostume it. Tap a cat.

title: September Briefs
note: After Anna Galitskaya's art challenge calendars: a month of briefs as twelve tiny finished pictures, cozy cats, an autumn wreath, mushrooms, a golden sun, a fox, a winter forest, one accent colour per cell, the calendar quietly re-inking itself cell by cell. Double-tap for a fresh month. Watch it fill, double-tap to reseed.

title: Triple Prompt
note: After Anna Galitskaya's Wonderful Winter Week: a prompt engine in one character, one garment, one animal, one thing per deal, a jaguar in a knitted accessory holding a festive headband and seven stranger meetings after it. Double-tap to deal the next triple, drag to sway the model. Double-tap to deal again.

title: Wimmelwald
note: After Anna Galitskaya's Wimmelwald: a snowy forest village at dusk, candle gold in the windows, a frozen lake below, and ten tiny stories hiding in it, skating bears, a badger family with a tree, gnomes at the bakery, a letter fox, a choir of mice. Tap a scene to lean in close, double-tap to step back. Tap a hidden scene.

title: The Secret Life of the Still Life
note: After Maryna Lagereva's still life doctrine: pears and a squash on a wooden table, watercolor quiet but quietly alive, the pears leaning together like conspirators, the stem curling, a beetle crossing once a minute, under her line: if your pictures do not tell a story, they are worthless. Drag near a pear and it leans to listen. Drag to lean a pear.

title: What Does This Bean Become?
note: After Maryna Lagereva's bean game: one ink bean on watercolor paper that refuses to stay a bean, an acorn dreaming of Napoleon, a rabbit swimming in borscht, an egg becoming a chick, each tap morphing it one stage further. Tap to transform it, double-tap for a fresh bean. Tap to morph.

title: F is for Fox
note: After Maryna Lagereva's ABC book: one picture-book card, a huge coral letter with the animal bursting across it and her funny-fact line beneath, opening on F is for fox, fascinating, furry, and fast. Double-tap to turn the page through the alphabet menagerie. Double-tap for the next card.

title: Too Small to Matter
note: After Maryna Lagereva's tiny marine stories: a pale sea spirit kneeling by a glowing purple flabellina on a dark seabed, light rays shifting, plankton rising, and her four-line dialogue as caption cards below. Tap to turn the conversation. Tap to advance the story.

title: Vulnerable
note: After Maryna Lagereva's conservation cards: a yelkouan shearwater gliding over a wash sea with its pale reflection rippling below, ink underdrawing showing, and beneath it her data strip, five status bands with Vulnerable lit in orange and one fact line. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Sun Moon Cloud
note: After Maryna Lagereva's folklore field: folk suns with closed-eye faces, cream crescents, scalloped clouds and pine silhouettes on khaki green, navy stars twinkling, the clouds drifting on slow crossings. Drag to stir the sky, the motifs swirl and settle home. Drag to stir.

title: Cloud Dancer Tiles
note: After Maryna Lagereva's Delft whimsy: 64 hand-wobbled tiles in strict Delft blue on white, cats, cupcakes, waves, palms, tomatoes, sailboats, books and hearts where the windmills used to be, and one Cloud Dancer tile hiding a single tiny cloud. A glaze shimmer sweeps as tiles redraw themselves. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Toile, But Make It Yoga
note: After Maryna Lagereva's toile subversion: classic Toile de Jouy vignettes on warm paper, but the scenes are yoga poses, warrior, tree, downward dog, dancer, lotus, cobra, child and crescent, inked in loud coral, teal, mustard and plum, breathing slowly like held poses. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Peaceful Birch
note: After Jen K's Peaceful Birch: eleven pale birch trunks on a moody teal-black ground, black bark marks, sage leaves low in the understory and gold leaf-dots falling slowly through a faint drifting mist. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Palm Springs Fever
note: After Jen K's Palm Springs fever dream: a flat midcentury desert, banded sunset sky, low sun, dunes and one palm silhouette, with two translucent strata sliding over it, teal cacti and stars below, big purple paisleys and sunbursts above. Watch only. Watch only.

title: First Collection, Again
note: After Jen K's archive mining: a maximalist toss rebuilt from her own ten-motif bank, crescents, eyes, moths, ravens, tulips and more, each generation drawing five to seven of them in a single palette duo on near-black. Double-tap for the next collection from the archive. Double-tap for a new generation.

title: Witchy Woman
note: After Jen K's Witchy Woman: a dense jewel-tone floral toss on near-black plum, poppies, daisies and chrysanthemums with gold moons, evil-eye dots and crystal shards in every gap, blooms pulsing as the gold shimmers. Drag to carry a moonlight through it. Drag to carry the moonlight.

title: Boho Jungle
note: After Jen K's Boho Jungle: five flat hero animals on light beige, a spotted leopard, striped tigers and a zebra packed in spiky leaves and berry dots with no space left over, leaves swaying as the animals breathe. Drag near an animal and it turns toward you, then settles. Drag to turn.

title: Romantsy Toile
note: After Jen K's Romantasy Toile: purple line-art vignettes on cream, dragons, castles, books, swords and crowns in half-drop, no filled shapes, a faint sparkle over them, the whole field inking itself in, holding, and fading to redraw. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Marine Building Fan
note: After Jen K's Marine Building fan: an art-deco sunburst on near-black, 36 gold ray bundles spreading 140 degrees with cream moons, eyes and crystals shrinking toward the arc and one oxblood band, a shimmer sweeping the rays as they breathe. Watch only. Watch only.

title: Night Sky Toss
note: After Jen K's Undersea Night Sky: a dense celestial toss on deep navy, 240 flat icons in three bands, gold moons and whales, moths and all-seeing eyes, crystals and tiny houses, the gold stars twinkling as everything drifts. Drag to stir the field, the icons swirl and settle home. Drag to stir.

title: Hydrangea Bloom

Drag across it to ripple the florets, double-tap to move the light. Drag to ripple, double-tap to move the light.

title: Dark Eggs
note: After Olena Kovalova's Dark Eggs: twelve near-black eggs on near-black, each a gold field of tiny thistles, crescents, eye-spirals and cross-stitch diamonds inside a thin gold ring, sprigs in the gutters, the gold shimmering. Tap an egg to open its locket, drag to scramble them home. Tap to open, drag to scramble.

Drag near a wing to ripple the tiles, double-tap to reseed the mosaic. Drag to ripple, double-tap to reseed.

title: Sunflower Suite
note: After Olena Kovalova's collection architecture: six panels from one motif library, hero sunflower toss, owl print on sage, petal blender on chocolate, gingham check, line-art sketch and sepia bird flight, each looping gently. Tap a panel to expand it, drag sideways to scrub the suite. Tap to expand, drag to scrub.

title: Eye-Spiral Tree
note: After Olena Kovalova's vyshyvanka Tree of Life: a mirror-symmetric tree on cream with three tiers of eye-spiral flowers, teal irises ringed in ochre and coral, flanking birds and diamond cross-stitch borders, the eyes rotating slowly. Drag across it to sway the branches, double-tap for a new iris palette. Drag to sway, double-tap for new irises.

title: Hummingbird Trailing
note: After Olena Kovalova's Timeless Nursery: Morris-style trailing vines on cream with fine-line hummingbirds hovering at the nodes, wings fluttering on their hover bob, the whole field drifting slowly downward. Tap a bird and it darts to a new node, drag to pan the trailing. Tap a bird, drag to pan.

title: Fiddlehead Biome
note: After Olena Kovalova's Forest Biome: a fern toss on near-black, forty fiddleheads uncurling and re-curling on staggered phases, arching fronds and cream butterflies in the gaps. Drag through it for a breeze, the fronds bend and the butterflies scatter and resettle. Drag for a breeze.

title: Thistle Crest
note: After Olena Kovalova's Dark Academia damask: a mirrored thistle crest in antique-gold linework on near-black, repeated half-drop with spread-wing ravens woven between the columns, the gold breathing slowly. Drag sideways to shear the lattice, double-tap for the next heraldic crest. Drag to shear, double-tap for a new crest.

title: Salt Air
note: After Julianne Haness's Salt Air: a faded coastal repeat of wave-scallop rows in sea-glass, sand, coral and washed navy, gulls and blossom sprays scattered through it, the rows drifting at three gentle speeds. Drag to pan, double-tap to change the song. Drag to pan, double-tap to change the song.

title: Poe Traits
note: After Julianne Haness's Poe-traits: portrait medallions of Poe, dark hair, moustache and high collar in parchment and ink, in a diamond grid on plum-ink, with ravens, keyholes, quills and skull-moths between, the whole field breathing like candlelight. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed the motifs. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed.

title: Lobster Stripefield
note: After Julianne Haness's lobsters and stripes: bold navy and cream horizontal bands sliding slowly like a tide, hand-drawn coral lobsters stamped along the stripe boundaries and riding them. Drag to pan, double-tap to flip to the sunset stripes. Drag to pan, double-tap to flip.

title: Sandpiper Pair
note: After Julianne Haness's sandpipers: cream sandpipers in conversing pairs on warm caramel, stippled umber feather texture, long legs and probing beaks, one head dipping now and then in each pair. Drag to pan, double-tap to reshuffle the pairs. Drag to pan, double-tap to reshuffle.

title: Dandelion Medallions
note: After Julianne Haness's Dandelions: a purple vine scrollwork lattice on salmon framing giant coral dandelion medallions, crisp starbursts with dot fills, rotating slowly as the vines sway. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed the medallions. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed.

title: Snowy Owl Stare
note: After Julianne Haness's Snowy Owls: giant snowy-owl faces in half-drop repeat on gold-ochre, black brow wedges and orange eyes staring straight out, blinking one at a time on a slow stagger. Drag to pan, double-tap to change who blinks first. Drag to pan.

title: Stingray Trellis
note: After Julianne Haness's Stingray Wallpaper: white-etched stingrays whose wingspans interlock into an ogee trellis on black, ring-dot starfield in the gaps, wings breathing slowly. Drag to pan, double-tap to reseed the starfield. Drag to pan, double-tap for new stars.

title: Goldline Poppies
note: After Julianne Haness's Dramatic Deco Poppies: oversized deep-teal poppy heads at wallpaper scale, every petal edge traced in a flat gold contour on near-black, breathing on a slow bloom pulse. Drag to pan, double-tap to flip to the golden colourway. Drag to pan, double-tap to flip.

title: Dark Academia, Three Ways

Double-tap for a new collection in the same palette. Double-tap for a new collection.

title: Six Colorways
note: After Suchita Prakash's colourway sheets: one hero motif set of sunflower, moth and oak spray rendered six times as a contact sheet, each cell in a different flat palette, breathing gently. Tap a cell to promote its colourway full-bleed, double-tap to come back to a fresh set. Tap a cell, double-tap to return.

title: Delft Tiles

title: Prairie Plaid Bloom

title: Owl and Oak Damask

title: Neon Midnight Garden
note: After Suchita Prakash's Neon midnight garden: dense flat neon florals, dahlias, sunflowers and moths in hot pink and violet on near-black, opening and closing in travelling waves. Drag through them and the blooms lean away and spring back. Drag to disturb the garden.

title: Harlequin Overflow

note: After Emi Bee's chunky tweed: thousands of short thread strokes woven in rows in three yarn colours, a slow sheen band travelling the weave while a bone moth and crescent moon drift half-buried in it. Watch only. Watch.

title: Murder in the Garden

title: Enid Engine
note: After Emi Bee's Enid floral: a twisty ogee damask on near-black that grows inward from the edges, ember blooms opening at the branch tips, then recedes and begins again on a twenty-eight-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

note: After Emi Bee's cheater quilt: twenty squares of celestial, tweed, pinstripe, damask and star patterns with printed sew-lines between them, each square looping on its own. Double-tap a square to advance its pattern. Double-tap to resew a square.

title: Harlequin Haunt
note: After Emi Bee's harlequin diamonds: fifty-four diamonds, each holding exactly one ghost, cat, star, swirl or bat, with a slow wave pulse rippling across the grid. Drag to push the wave. Drag to disturb the haunt.

title: Night Visitors
note: After Emi Bee's hidden-motif damask: an antique ogee lattice in bone on near-black, with sixteen ghosts, bats and owls hidden in the same ink, only their ember eyes blinking in slow sequence. Drag to pan and zoom and hunt for them. Drag to hunt.

note: After MyClayCo's failed print: a cream toolpath draws a scalloped frame neatly for eight seconds, then the print fails and it blooms into a hot-coral tangle before the bed clears. Drag to feed noise into the line. Drag to make spaghetti.

note: After MyClayCo's trinket dishes: a twelve-petal dish seen from directly above on near-black, shaded in four flat teal bands, turning slowly while a ripple travels petal to petal on a twenty-eight-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

title: Flat Net
note: After MyClayCo's bow cutter: a flat paper net of a bow, loops, knot and tails with dashed terracotta score lines, folding itself up into a dusty-rose bow and unfolding again on a twenty-four-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

title: Make Shake
note: After MyClayCo's Make Shake game: three dice roll a profile, a stack count and a palette, and the study below is built from exactly that roll. Double-tap to shake again and the picture re-rolls with the dice. Double-tap to shake.

title: Click-In Grammar
note: After MyClayCo's Click n Clay Multi Jig: six rainbow-arch cells, each holding one cream insert from a set of four - star, heart, flower, dot. Tap a cell to click a new insert in, double-tap to re-deal the board. Tap a cell, double-tap to re-deal.

title: Puffy
note: After MyClayCo's puffy fridge frames: a small blob form inflating and deflating on a sixteen-second loop, shaded in stepped flat bands with no gradient anywhere. Drag across it to dent it, it springs back. Drag to dent.

title: Double Inset
note: After MyClayCo's Double Ellipse Inset Hoopla: three nested ellipses on near-black, the middle ring scalloped in gold, eight small inset studies around the margin. Drag sideways to slide the middle ring, it eases home on release. Drag to slide the inset.

title: Cutter Stack
note: After MyClayCo's bird cutter stacks: one hand-wobbled bird profile as seven concentric outlines at a one-and-a-half size progression, breathing like a cut being pressed and released on a twenty-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

title: Red Triangle
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's degree show: a tall red-lit triangle in a black room, fire churning inside it, dark masks at its base with red-lit eyes, the edge light breathing on a thirty-second cycle. Watch only. Watch.

title: Raudra Roop
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Raudra Roop: a wrathful glazed mask, crown of skulls and spiral brows, perfectly still while its turquoise glaze flows and pools in the crevices on a sixty-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

title: Spring Convenor
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Spring Convenor: a bamboo mirror on black fabric, covered in red hand-written strips, one carrying her line about Nature as God. Pass a finger near the strips and they lean toward you. Move near the strips to lean them.

title: At Nature's Mercy
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's At Nature's Mercy: a sheer grey curtain in a dark room, one small black-and-white mountain low on the fabric, breathing almost imperceptibly on a forty-second cycle. Watch only. Watch.

title: Cartographies of Cloth
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Cartographies of Cloth: felted contour lines in rust and terracotta with one dark river ribbon running the steepest path through them. Drag to raise the land and the river finds a new way down. Drag to reshape the terrain.

title: Singhay Chosgyal
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Singhay Chosgyal: a white-line wrathful deity in eight-fold symmetry on black, perfectly still, while a red, yellow and green field churns inside its disc. Watch only. Watch.

title: Fear Hope Field
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's two-pole palette: a stepped dye-lot field running diagonally from warning red to wellbeing teal, drifting on slow currents. Touch to resolve the colour where you press; double-tap for a new current. Touch the field; double-tap to reseed.

title: Ways of Protection
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Ways of Protection at Old Leh: nine kite forms hung in dark air, triangular windows glowing rose to peach as each kite drifts along her fear-to-hope axis. Drag through them to gust the field. Drag to gust the kites.

title: Moonbeams
note: After Debbie Sharman's moonlight scallops: a dark field of scallop tiles, a cream moon and gold beams in each, alternating by default because she could not choose. Tap a tile to flip it; double-tap to try another arrangement. Tap a tile; double-tap to rearrange.

title: Cheater Quilt
note: After Debbie Sharman's cheater quilt: a 5 by 5 grid of squares pretending to be sewn, plaid, daisy-scallop, starburst and berry stripes, one square always re-sewing itself stroke by stroke. Tap a square to swap its pattern. Tap a square.

title: Swirling Vines
note: After Debbie Sharman's Swirling Vines: six jungle vines trailing down a cream ground, curling and unfurling at their tips, daisies and leaves at their nodes. Drag through them to bend them like wind. Drag to bend the vines.

title: Buffalo Plaid Bee
note: After Debbie Sharman's buffalo plaid bee entry: a bold red and black plaid with one cartoon bee resting on every few checks, wings shivering in turn. Drag across the plaid to lift the bees near your finger. Drag to disturb the bees.

title: Thirty Days, One Palette
note: After Debbie Sharman's 30-day fixed-palette collab: thirty tiles in a 6 by 5 grid, a fox, holly, a wreath and twenty-seven more prompts from her Natural Christmas list, every tile drawn in the same five colours. Tap a tile to see its prompt up close. Tap a tile.

title: Celestial Gingko
note: After Debbie Sharman's Celestial Gingko texture: scalloped rows of gold-line gingko fans on a near-black teal ground, tiny cream flowers at their bases, a shimmer travelling row by row. Tap a fan to shed its gold spores. Tap a fan.

title: Hide and Seek
note: After Debbie Sharman's hide-and-seek wallpaper: a dense daisy and gingko field in greens and teal, seven butterflies hidden in it by colour, worms, snails and spiders planted to mislead. Tap a butterfly when you spot one; double-tap for a fresh field. Tap to seek; double-tap to reseed.

title: Scallop Field
note: After Debbie Sharman's scallop tiles: a full field of scalloped cells, gingko fans and tiny daisies alternating, a slow wave turning the cells over diagonally. Tap a cell to flip its orientation. Tap a cell.

title: Cockatoo Press
note: After Coral Cockatoo's brand bird: a sulphur-crested cockatoo in flat print colours on eucalyptus teal, crest rising and falling, perched on a diagonal branch. Tap for three quick head-bobs. Tap for a head-bob.

title: Crackle Screen
note: After Coral Cockatoo's Marble Crackle screen: a black crackle network printed flat on white, a window onto an endless field, a few cells tinted celadon. Drag to pan the field; tap for a new constellation. Drag to pan; tap to reseed.

title: Three Architectures
note: After Coral Cockatoo's botanical screens: three flower architectures side by side, a banksia cone of spikelets, a bottlebrush of swaying filaments, wattle poms on branching stems. Tap a panel to regrow it in a new variant. Tap a panel.

title: Monoline Study
note: After Coral Cockatoo's monoline drawings: one black line, one weight, drawing a gum blossom, a wattle spray and a banksia cone in turn on white paper, each in a single unbroken-weight hand. Tap to skip to the next specimen. Tap to skip.

title: Three-Part Registration
note: After Coral Cockatoo's three-part screens: one botanical composition printed in vermilion, teal and mustard layers, overlaps mixing where the inks cross. Drag a layer out of registration; double-tap to snap it back. Drag a layer; double-tap to register.

title: Ditzy Field
note: After Coral Cockatoo's ditzy prints: a full field of teeny vermilion gum blossoms on cream paper, a slow swell wave crossing diagonally. Drag to press the motifs up to full size under your finger. Drag to press.

title: Gum Blossom Engine
note: After Coral Cockatoo's Eucalyptus Blossoms screen: six gum blossoms on the dark, caps lifting, gold stamens unfurling in bursts, narrow leaves on woody stems. Tap a blossom to scatter its stamens and watch it regrow. Tap a blossom.

title: Potion Pair
note: After Xanthe Caesia's potion bottles: a raku black bottle and a cream cobalt-swirled bottle, linked by a gold thread between their corks, potion light glowing at each seam. Drag one and its pair follows; tap a cork for a pulse. Drag a bottle; tap a cork.

title: Marble & Transfer
note: After Xanthe Caesia's marbled mugs: brown-and-cream swirled clay with a crisp black silkscreen transfer, wattle, bee, banksia or butterfly, stamped over it. Drag to re-swirl the clay under the print; tap to stamp the next motif. Drag to stir the clay; tap to stamp.

title: Embellish & Cast
note: After Xanthe Caesia's mould ritual: a plain plaster mould, the same form embellished with band, crimped rim, feet and a sprig, and three slip-cast copies in red, grey and black. Tap the middle to draw on a new variant; tap the casts for a new colorway. Tap a stage.

title: Tower of Chance
note: After Xanthe Caesia's wizard towers: a stacked clay tower with glowing slits, backflow smoke at its chimney and mist at its seams, three bone dice at its foot. Drag a die into the roof mouth and it tumbles out the door; tap the chimney for a backflow pulse. Drag a die; tap the chimney.

title: Arcane Inventory
note: After Xanthe Caesia's Arcanum releases: an apothecary shelf of her cauldrons, potion bottles, pumpkin jars, gem boxes and towers, each with its numbered release plate, rarity and usage line, and three field applications below. Tap a vessel to issue the next release. Tap a vessel.

title: Tiny Hut Row
note: After Xanthe Caesia's incense cottages: five tiny cream huts on chicken feet under a night sky, incense smoke curling from every chimney, one hut now and then scratching and settling. Tap a hut to flare its window and pour the smoke. Tap a hut.

title: Scrying Cauldron
note: After Xanthe Caesia's cauldron mugs: a squat dark cauldron with a jagged flame rim and two glowing vents, a tea-light beside it, the black liquid inside holding faint drifting visions. Drag to stir the scrying pool; tap the rim for a gold glint. Drag to stir; tap the rim.

title: Wagtail Loop
note: After Ali Fisher's willy wagtail: a black-and-white wagtail in white linework on deep navy, tail pumping in its real herky-jerky bursts, three, pause, two, over banksia pods and eucalyptus. Watch-only.

title: Flash Sheet Twelve
note: After Ali Fisher's twelve-print series: a flash sheet of twelve motifs, cowboy, cranes, Pharaoh's horses, parrot, panther, snake, croc, wagtail, banksia and mermaid, with hand-lettered labels. Drag cells to mix and match; tap one for its signature move. Drag to rearrange; tap a cell.

title: Tile Trial Grid
note: After Ali Fisher's sgraffito tile trials: twenty handmade crackle-glazed tiles on dark timber, each carved through to the clay with a flower, bird, skull or banksia pod, one corner tile mended with gold. Tap a tile to re-carve it; drag to shift the tabletop. Tap a tile.

title: Swan Quartet
